summary: Security update for the Linux Kernel (Live Patch 75 for SUSE Linux Enterprise 12 SP5)
details:
This update for the SUSE Linux Enterprise Kernel 4.12.14-122.283 fixes various security issues:

The following security issues were fixed:

- CVE-2026-53016: crypto: ccp - copy IV using skcipher ivsize (bsc#1269766).
- CVE-2026-68426: xfrm: fix stale skb->prev after async crypto steals a GSO segment (bsc#1274712).
- CVE-2026-74469: sctp: prevent peer transport count overflow (bsc#1280693).
- CVE-2026-74669: ipvs: clear IPv4 options after rebasing tunnel ICMP errors (bsc#1277399).
- CVE-2026-89544: SUNRPC: fix gssx_dec_option_array error path bugs (bsc#1280760).
- CVE-2026-89551: SUNRPC: xdr_buf_trim: clamp buf->len to avoid underflow (bsc#1280728).
- CVE-2026-89674: nfsd: fix XDR length calculation in nfsd4_ff_encode_layoutget (bsc#1280285).
- CVE-2026-98432: ipv4: free inet_opt and ireq_opt after an RCU grace period (bsc#1285686).
